notes: Switch customer and notifier together, all instances at once, so an old notifier cannot send queued offers after the customer explicit-opt-in rule becomes active. The new notifier also re-checks consent when consuming queued events. An unavailable consent endpoint is treated as an older customer instance for mixed-version compatibility; other failures leave the event for retry. Drain queued offers before rollout so the additive daily-state migration starts from a stable sent history. Preserve sent and offer_daily on rollback.
